description: Current Altcoin Season Index (0-100: share of the top 50 coins by market cap, stablecoins and wrapped tokens excluded, that beat Bitcoin over the trailing 90 days; 75 or above is altcoin season, 25 or below is Bitcoin season) with the count of outperforming coins, Bitcoin's 90-day change and the last 12 month-end readings. Use this when the user asks whether it is altcoin season or how altcoins are performing against Bitcoin. Refreshed daily; history is month-end only, computed point-in-time from that date's top-50 ranking.
name: get_altcoin_season
title: Altcoin Season Index
